note: Fiji's largest banks are BSP Fiji, ANZ Fiji and Westpac Fiji. ANZ Fiji: its interest rates page gives its Visa Classic, its only personal credit card, 20.50% a year; its disclosure of fees and charges for lending and credit cards (effective 23 September 2026) gives a $50 joining fee, a $50 annual fee, a $20 late payment fee, a $7.50 dishonoured cheque fee, a $5.00 cash advance fee, a 1.5% currency conversion fee and up to 45 interest-free days. The Visa Business card isn't written. BSP Fiji's interest rates (current at 7 September 2026) give its VISA Essential and VISA Gold 20.75% a year, but both of its lending and credit card fee schedules linked from its card pages answered 404 and its banking services brochure (10 August 2026) prices no credit card, so its cards' fees aren't known and they aren't written. Westpac Fiji's card terms weren't reached.
